# KMR LIVE

> Karnataka Market Reports (KMR LIVE) is South India's premier commodity market reporting and intelligence platform, delivering verified daily mandi rates, price movements, and agricultural trends.

KMR LIVE connects farmers, traders, brokers, processors, wholesalers, and retail businesses with real-time price updates across edible oils, coconut products, pulses, grains, spices, and groceries.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://wa.kmrlive.in/): Real-time commodity market highlights, product categories, daily price trends, and mobile app download.
- [About Us](https://wa.kmrlive.in/about): Background, history, mission, and trusted market reporting coverage across South India.
- [Contact Us](https://wa.kmrlive.in/contact): Customer support, trade enquiries, office contact details, and partnership requests.
- [Market Insights & Blog](https://wa.kmrlive.in/blog): Daily commodity price analysis, mandi rate trends, and agricultural trade news.

## Key Commodity Categories

- [Edible Oil](https://wa.kmrlive.in/#categories): Spot rates for Sunflower Oil, Palm Oil, Mustard Oil, Rice Bran Oil, and Groundnut Oil.
- [Coconut & Coconut Oil](https://wa.kmrlive.in/#categories): Daily rates for Copra, Raw Coconut, and Coconut Oil.
- [Pulses](https://wa.kmrlive.in/#categories): Wholesale prices for Tur Dal, Urad Dal, Moong Dal, Gram Dal, and Chana.
- [Rice & Paddy](https://wa.kmrlive.in/#categories): Mandi prices for Sona Masoori, Basmati, and regional varieties.
- [Spices & Dry Fruits](https://wa.kmrlive.in/#categories): Arecanut (Betel Nut), Black Pepper, Cardamom, Cashew, and Jaggery.
